en.text: Three weeks ago, the first case of Hema Aetho 26
was confirmed in Chicago.

第一起海玛艾托26病例

en.text: It spread quickly, one of the highest fatality rates ever recorded.

en.text: both appear to be Dr. Ryan Holder,

before we got here.

en.text: I'm responsible for the deaths of tens of thousands of humans.

en.text: Mija.

en.text: Who visited, when, technological assets, which…

zh.text: 谁造访过、何时造访过、科技资产

en.text: is of primary interest to us.

zh.text: 而这是我们最感兴趣的

en.text: We have a training session with the new scout team.

en.text: Well, I guess we'll catch up later.

en.text: We are so close.

zh.text: 我们就快研发成功了

en.text: How did you build it in this world?

zh.text: 你是如何在这个世界制造它的？

en.text: Well, we sourced the trickier components from other worlds.

en.text: You don't wanna know.

en.text: I don't, but obviously you have to tell me. So just…

en.text: - Of course I do.   - Yeah.

zh.text: - 当然想   - 是的

en.text: I have been thinking about the cube in the pool.

zh.text: 我一直在想泳池里的那个立方体

en.text: - Why?   - You know,

zh.text: - 为什么？   - 对了

en.text: Mom asked if I could bring her by your place to see the kids this weekend.

zh.text: 妈妈问我这周末 能不能带她去你家看看孩子们

en.text: These people are clearly super sophisticated corporate spies.

zh.text: 这些人显然是非常老练的企业间谍

en.text: Look, I know you don't give a shit about the family business,

zh.text: 听着 我知道你根本不在乎家族生意

en.text: Carbon levels spiked to 700 ppm.

zh.text: 二氧化碳浓度飙到了百万分之七百

en.text: - Jesus.   - Yeah.

zh.text: - 天啊   - 是的

en.text: And has anyone traveled in this Corridor?

zh.text: 有人使用过这条走廊吗？

en.text: No. No one has.

en.text: I know what you mean.

en.text: Oh, shit.

zh.text: 就离开了 他去见马克斯了

en.text: I don't know what to say.

zh.text: 我不知道该说什么

en.text: You know, the most important day of your life is the day you meet yourself.

en.text: If you ever need me, I'm here.

zh.text: 如果你需要我 随时找我

zh.text: 好了 去找你儿子吧

en.text: Hey.
Hi.

zh.text: 纯的

en.text: Yeah, yeah.

zh.text: 好了…

en.text: Actually, we got a place close by in Logan Square,

zh.text: 其实我们就住在洛根广场附近

en.text: and I work here and my son's in college.

zh.text: 我在这里上班 我儿子在读大学

en.text: - Wow.   - Yeah.

zh.text: - 天啊   - 是的

en.text: Look, I'd… I'd like to, but I got a lot of prep to finish

zh.text: 听着 我…很想 但我得在欢乐时光人潮到来前

en.text: before the happy hour rush, but thank you.

zh.text: 做很多准备工作 不过还是谢谢你

en.text: Yeah, it's about to get a little crazy in here.

zh.text: 对 待会儿这里会忙得不可开交

en.text: Just give me a sec.

zh.text: 等我一下

en.text: - Hey, Matt.   - Yeah.

zh.text: - 嘿 马特   - 是的

zh.text: 你哪来的钱建这实验室？

en.text: So, it turns out my counterpart in this world is a bit of a fuck-up.

zh.text: 这个世界里的我原来混得一塌糊涂

en.text: Brought some technological wonders from other worlds.

zh.text: 从其他世界找来了一些高端科技设备

en.text: Now, Velocity is the premier tech company that it should be.

zh.text: 极速现在总算配得上它该有的地位 一家首屈一指的科技公司

en.text: - Okay. Hello.   - I know. Thank you.

zh.text: - 好的 你好   - 我知道 谢谢

en.text: Yeah, we're all from the same world.

zh.text: 对 我们都来自同一个世界

en.text: Yeah.

zh.text: 好的
好

zh.text: 但我可能该走了

zh.text: 不…你可是我的客人

zh.text: 什么意思？

en.text: Well, there aren't screens everywhere, right?

zh.text: 这里不会到处都是屏幕 对吧？

en.text: People actually look at each other, talk to each other.

zh.text: 人们会有眼神交流 会互相交谈

en.text: Well, you are bringing a cell phone to market.

zh.text: 可你这不是要把手机引入市场吗？

en.text: What do you get up to in the box?

zh.text: 你在那个盒子里都干些什么呀？

en.text: You know, just try to survive.

zh.text: 就努力让自己活着

en.text: And they told me everything.

zh.text: 他们把一切都告诉了我

en.text: You know, I'm not proud of the things--

zh.text: 我并不以那些事为荣…

en.text: I had fear too.

zh.text: 我当时也带有恐惧

en.text: And so, after that,

zh.text: 在那之后

zh.text: - 这不是你的错   - 是我的错…

en.text: Yes, I am.

zh.text: 是我的错

en.text: but I can't even begin to put the pieces of this puzzle together

zh.text: 可我连个头绪都没有

en.text: in a way that makes any sense.

zh.text: 怎么也拼凑不出一个合理的解释

en.text: Like you don't even know.

zh.text: 你根本不晓得我有多认真

en.text: Look, I don't want to threaten you or your family, but I need to know--

zh.text: 听着 我不想威胁你 或你的家人 但我必须知道…

en.text: Okay.

en.text: Hey. Hey!

He's raking this huge pile of leaves

zh.text: 我最爱看的一段
是我爸在扫一整大堆的落叶

en.text: and he just keeps pushing them all around us.

zh.text: 他不停地把叶子往我们俩身边推

as the pile gets bigger and bigger.

zh.text: 看着那堆叶子越堆越高、越堆越大
我们俩就一直笑个不停

en.text: Still looking for antigens that they're not gonna fucking find.

zh.text: 天啊 这地方变独裁的速度也太快了？

en.text: Come on.
